title: Increased production of docosahexaenoic acid (22: 6 n‐3, DHA) in catfish nutritionally stressed by the feeding of oxidized oils and the modulatory effect of dietary α‐tocopheryl acetate

sections.abstract: <jats:p>Production of hepatic docosahexaenoic acid in juvenile <jats:italic>Clarias gariepinus</jats:italic> was significantly increased (<jats:italic>P</jats:italic> <0.05) by ingestion of rancid diets and this effect was modulated by dietary vitamin E. This has not been described previously in fish. Causal mechanisms are postulated.</jats:p>
